newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH KERA SAYS H1 FINANCING DEMAND STRONG.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH KERA SAYS H1 FINANCING DEMAND STRONG.

text.p: Finnish state-owner regional financing company Kera said in a statement on Tuesday that demand for financing was strong in the first half of the year, and that some 7,000 jobs had been created in its projects.
Its financing totalled 1.2 billion markka, some 67 percent of last year's 1.82 billion markka total.
Kera deputy managing director Veijo Ojala told Reuters that there was a boom in small enterprises, and Kera said the service sector accounted for 42 percent of financing in the first half.
"This is historically an exceptionally positive development," he said, adding growth was fuelled by financing demand among a new generation of young entrepeneurs in services.
"Small and medium size companies' investments and employment are in favourable growth," Kera said.
"The problem this year is becoming insufficient authorisation in the state budget. The issue should be solved in the supplementary budget for this year," Kera said.
